details.description:
Bernd Von Manteuffel (BVM) has worked in the European real estate world for more than 35 years. He is an acknowledged player in real estate investment and revaluation. He has co-founded several vehicles, including OK Haus und Immobilien Gmbh Property management (+€1 billion under management), Jurag AG (+€300 million under management) and Mercureim.

BVM is particularly active in the German real estate market where he has developed a wide network of major partners and investors.

He is also cofounder and member of the fund investment committees of the Mercureim EF1, and cofounder and administrator of the funds Everest One, BUILDIM and OCITY, subsidiaries of MIMCO Capital.

BVM is also Chairman of the Supervisory Board of the Paris-based portfolio management company MIMCO Asset Management, a subsidiary of MIMCO Capital.

details.description:
With 20 years of experience in the European real estate industry, Christophe Nadal has established himself as a prominent figure in real estate investment and private equity. His deep understanding of value creation mechanisms, complex deal structuring, and asset management allows him to approach all asset classes with both a strategic and operational lens.

An entrepreneur since the age of 23, he has built a solid expertise in brokerage, asset management, and the structuring of real estate funds. Holding a degree as a Real Estate Expert specializing in brokerage and asset management, he has gained significant experience working with major European funds, where he spearheaded flagship transactions across several countries.

Christophe Nadal is the co-founder and head of the MIMCO Capital group, which boasts over €2 billion in assets under management. Driven by a passion for innovation and digital transformation within the sector, he also serves as a board member of Lux PropTech in Luxembourg.

details.description:
With over 20 years of experience in financial management, fund structuring, and real estate asset management, Quentin Verschoren has built a strong reputation in investment and asset management at the European level.

Drawing on this rich and diverse background, Quentin Verschoren joined the MIMCO group as Chief Operating Officer to lead the group’s key operational activities.

He began his career at Deloitte and Mazars Luxembourg, auditing companies specialized in alternative investments.

He then continued his path at ICAMAP, where he served as Conducting Officer and Group CFO, overseeing financial, regulatory, and legal due diligence across Europe. He later joined AEW, where he held successive positions as Conducting Officer and Managing Director of the Luxembourg platform. Prior to joining MIMCO Capital, Quentin Verschoren was Country Director at ATENOR, where he managed the group’s strategic and financial operations related to real estate developments in Luxembourg.

Quentin is a Chartered Accountant, holds a Master’s degree in Business Administration from I.C.H.E.C (Brussels Management School), and is certified by RICS and as a Certified Expert in ESG & Impact Investing by the Frankfurt School of Finance & Management.

details.description:
Au cours de ses 15 années d’expérience à des positions stratégiques dans le secteur du corporate et des services immobiliers dans différentes entreprises en Allemagne, Louis Milse a acquis une solide expertise en matière de gestion, notamment dans les domaines des finances, du contrôle de gestion et des fusions et acquisitions.

Diplômé en administration des affaires (BA), Louis a commencé sa carrière professionnelle en tant qu’assistant du conseil d’administration d’une société cotée au MDax allemand. Il a ensuite participé à des projets de restructuration stratégique et de contrôle de gestion. Il a également occupé un poste de direction dans le domaine du contrôle de gestion chez l’un des leaders de la grande distribution en Allemagne, Edeka Zentrale AG & Co KG à Hambourg. Et plus récemment, en tant que membre du comité exécutif de l’entreprise technologique du secteur immobilier Kalorimeta GmbH, basée à Hambourg, il était principalement responsable des finances et du contrôle de gestion. Il a par ailleurs accompagné des activités de fusions-acquisitions et a acquis une connaissance approfondie dans ce domaine d’expertise.

Chez MIMCO Asset Management GmbH, Louis est Directeur et Membre du comité exécutif et sera chargé de structurer la croissance du groupe et de coordonner le financement des nouveaux projets.

Céline joins MIMCO as Head of Legal, bringing with her more than 17 years’ experience of company and investment fund law in Luxembourg.

Céline holds a Master’s degree in Business Law – European Business Lawyer – from the University of Lorraine, with an Erasmus year at the University of Leeds (UK). She also obtained a Magistère in European Business Law and took additional courses in Luxembourg law at the University of Luxembourg before being admitted to the Luxembourg Bar in 2007.

Céline began her career in the corporate and investment funds departments of two leading Luxembourg law firms, Clifford Chance LLP and Arendt & Medernach, where she acquired solid expertise in corporate law and real estate investment funds. She then joined Franklin Templeton, an international asset management company, where she held several key positions, including Senior Corporate Counsel and Deputy Head of Luxembourg Legal, during her 12 years with the company. More recently, she was Corporate Legal Counsel at Mangopay SA, a fintech specialising in third-party payment solutions for marketplaces and crowdfunding platforms, where she oversaw corporate governance and provided legal support to the management, finance and human resources teams.

At MIMCO Capital, Céline will use her expertise and wealth of experience to lead the company’s legal activities, strengthening the group’s ability to operate in complex regulatory environments and secure its operations and investments.

With more than 25 years of experience in construction and real estate, Olivier has a comprehensive command of the entire development cycle of a project: land acquisition and value creation, urban planning, legal and financial feasibility, technical coordination, operational management, ESG integration and circular economy strategies. He graduated from ESTP Paris and holds a Master’s degree (Master II) in Innovation Management. He also holds the regulated authorization to practice real estate professions in Luxembourg.

After starting his career in technical roles at VINCI and Schroeder & Associés, followed by QSHE and methods positions at SE Consult and CLE, he launched his own consulting activity in 2013, specializing in Lean Construction and real estate development, supporting developers and construction companies on complex projects.

In 2017, he joined ATENOR Luxembourg, where he led major operations and supervised feasibility studies, financing structures, administrative negotiations, and ESG strategy.

Today, as Project Development Director at MIMCO, he structures and secures residential, office and mixed-use developments, coordinates multidisciplinary teams, and ensures overall project performance through a strong focus on risk management, efficiency and sustainability.

With more than 10 years of experience, Benjamin Boidin covers the full lifecycle of real estate funds: valuation, cash management, debt, reporting, and compliance. He is a certified Chartered Accountant and holds the CGPC (Certified Wealth Management Advisor), AMF and AMF Sustainable Finance certifications.

He began his career in accounting and audit between Paris and London, before joining Mazars in 2016, where he advised asset managers and real estate funds on accounting, taxation, valuation, and consolidation, while contributing to the development of the firm’s real estate offering.

In 2021, he joined Lifento as a Fund Manager. There, he took part in fund management, structuring of vehicles and acquisitions, coordination of due diligence processes across several European countries, cash and debt management, as well as monitoring regulatory requirements—actively contributing to the firm’s SRI (Socially Responsible Investment) labeling efforts.

Today, at MIMCO Asset Management, he leads the design of new projects and the operational management of funds, with a performance-driven approach focused on risk management and ESG integration.

He began his career in accounting and audit between Paris and London, before joining Mazars in 2016, where he advised asset managers and real estate funds on accounting, taxation, valuation, and consolidation, while contributing to the development of the firm’s real estate offering.

In 2021, he joined Lifento as a Fund Manager. There, he took part in fund management, structuring of vehicles and acquisitions, coordination of due diligence processes across several European countries, cash and debt management, as well as monitoring regulatory requirements—actively contributing to the firm’s SRI (Socially Responsible Investment) labeling efforts.

Today, at MIMCO Asset Management, he leads the design of new projects and the operational management of funds, with a performance-driven approach focused on risk management and ESG integration.

description:
Maximilien Lemme has a highly developed sense of interpersonal skills and has been building his career in finance for over 10 years, with a strong expertise in real estate asset management and in supporting wealth advisors throughout France.

His last 4 years at the real estate management company Perial AM, initially as an Account Manager and later as Head of CGP Partnerships, have solidified his understanding of the financial sector and refined his skills in partnership management. Maximilien began his career in wealth management at BNP Paribas, where he successively held the positions of Wealth Advisor and Business-to-Business Account Manager. He also contributed to the growth of Foncia Pierre Gestion as an Account Manager for CGPI Partners and Client Relations.

Maximilien’s academic journey started with a diploma in Retail Unit Management. Furthermore, he serves as a lecturer at INSEEC, teaching in support of Master’s programs in Wealth Management and Real Estate Markets to pass on his real estate expertise.

At MIMCO Asset Management, Maximilien is responsible for developing and nurturing a network of B-to-B partners in the French market, primarily in the Western region

details.description:
Gabriel began his professional career in a real estate development company in Colombia as assistant project manager and then in a design office in France as structural engineer, which enabled him to familiarize himself with the real estate sector.

After Colombia and France, Gabriel decided to pursue his career in Luxembourg, where he first joined the offices of BGL BNP Paribas bank as a real estate valuation analyst in the credit department for real estate professionals, honing a valuable expertise in estimating the value and profitability of real estate projects and properties.

After BGL BNP Paribas, Gabriel decided to join Immobel, a major Belgian real estate development listed company, as an investment analyst. For almost two years, Gabriel was part of the development team, monitoring acquisitions and disposals of residential and commercial projects, and providing recommendations following analysis of opportunities. He was also involved in the asset management of Immobel’s office portfolio and liaised with the various counterparties.

Gabriel holds a Master’s degree in International Financial Analysis from NEOMA Business School in Reims, an institution renowned for its academic excellence in the field of international finance. This in-depth training enabled him to acquire solid knowledge in financial analysis, asset valuation and portfolio management.

As Investment & Corporate Finance Manager at MIMCO Capital, his main role is to manage and optimize the Group’s real estate portfolio. He participates in the development of investment strategies, carries out in-depth analyses of the real estate market in Luxembourg, France, Germany and, more broadly, Europe, following the operations developed by the Group, identifies investment opportunities, works with the teams to carry out real estate asset acquisitions and disposals, and ensures that assets are managed efficiently.

description:
Jean-Baptiste holds an engineering degree from Polytech Nancy and brings over 10 years of experience in managing large-scale real estate developments in Luxembourg. Renowned for his rigorous approach and his ability to generate sustainable value, he possesses a comprehensive command of the entire development cycle, from land acquisition to commercialization.

Now a Senior Project Manager at MIMCO, Jean-Baptiste provides a cross-functional perspective on local urban challenges. He previously made a significant impact on the Luxembourg real estate landscape at BESIX RED, where he led the flagship Parc Septfontaines project, serving as the central liaison between public institutions, financial partners, and design and construction teams.

His upward career trajectory within industry leaders such as Bouygues, KONE, and Otis enabled him to structure complex engineering departments and head TheLuxLab, a subsidiary dedicated to technical innovation. Jean-Baptiste is multilingual fluent in French, English, and German, and has further enriched his profile with studies in constitutional law at Sciences Po Nancy.

description:
Active for more than 13 years in the fiduciary field in Luxembourg, Fanny Picard benefits from solid skills in accounting and financial management.

During her years of work experience, she has evolved within the Ocorian group (formerly MAS Luxembourg), a world leader in corporate and fiduciary services, fund administration and capital markets. At first, Fanny worked in the front office in the accounting management of client companies before joining the back office to develop her skills in managing commercial companies. 

She graduated from the Paul Verlaine University in Metz (France) with a professional degree in organizational management.

As a Finance Manager, Fanny is responsible for the financial and administrative management of the Luxembourg companies of the MIMCO Capital group, as well as the organization of automation processes.

description:
With almost 10 years of experience in fiduciary companies in Luxembourg, Hoang Cao Minh has acquired solid knowledge in accounting, auditing and taxes. He has also recently developed skills within regulated structures, more particularly in the real estate sector.

Graduated in accounting and taxation at Hénallux in Belgium, Hoang built his career and sharpened his experience within the Ocorian group, a world leader in corporate and fiduciary services, fund administration and capital markets. In particular, he was in charge of a portfolio of financial holding companies for 7 years and of regulated funds for 3 years.

Today, Hoang manages the accounting of the real estate assets of the MIMCO Capital Group located in Luxembourg.
